title: Shachna

paragraphs: [Tosafot on Yoma 38b](https://www.sefaria.org/Tosafot_on_Yoma.38b.4.1), s.v. dela, reads Shachna in the baraita in [Shabbat 12b](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.12b.1). The text Hyman uses reads Shavna.[^1]

notes.text: Tosafot gives “Hillel and Shachna,” explaining the reading in light of the wicked biblical Shavna. It also discusses the proposal that there were two biblical figures named Shavna. Compare [Seder HaDorot](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=3319&lang=en).
